rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing: landlord use ban
rules.requirement: The proposed ordinance would make it unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property. Each month a violation exists or continues, and each residential rental property where a landlord uses an algorithmic device, would be a separate and distinct violation.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation
rules.coverage_text: Landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego. An algorithmic device is software or a product that uses or incorporates one or more algorithms to perform calculations of nonpublic competitor data concerning rental rates, occupancy levels, or other information regarding the leasing of residential rental property to advise a landlord on, or recommend to a landlord, rental rates or occupancy levels.
rules.exemptions: Algorithmic device does not include: (a) software or a product used to publish reports regarding rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from information available to the general public, that does not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; (b) software or a product used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation in a civil action against a landlord; a prevailing tenant shall recover costs and reasonable attorney's fees. Remedies are cumulative.
rules.quoted_span: (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
rules.interaction_text: The remedies under section 98.1104 are cumulative and are in addition to any other remedies in this Division or at law, statute, or ordinance.

rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing: sale and licensing ban
rules.requirement: The proposed ordinance would make it unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.coverage_text: Any person selling, licensing, or otherwise providing algorithmic devices to landlords, where the device advises or recommends rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in the City of San Diego using nonpublic competitor data.
rules.exemptions: Algorithmic device does not include: (a) software or a product used to publish reports regarding rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from information available to the general public, that does not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; (b) software or a product used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
